name: softglaze
description: SoftGlaze plugins for Claude: SoftGlaze Browser (isolated browser profiles) and SoftGlaze Proxy Switcher (browser proxy extension).

plugins.name: softglaze-browser
plugins.description: Work with SoftGlaze Browser profiles, proxies, macros and page tools from Claude. Every change waits for your approval in the app.

plugins.name: softglaze-proxy
plugins.description: Let Claude use the SoftGlaze Proxy Switcher extension for Chrome and Edge through the SoftGlaze Proxy Bridge.
